senses.gloss:
The affixes क -- प्रागिवात्कः ५.३.७०, and अकच् (अक्) -- अव्ययसर्वनाम्नामकच् प्राक् टेः ५.३.७१, come after a word, noun or verb, when something or somebody not known is spoken of.

Terms: क and अकच् (अक्)

Also before आज्ञायिन् the Instrumental -3rd case endings of मनस् are not elided.

Terms: विभक्ति-Non-elision
